title: Interview message
description: One question or answer in an interview. Its key is the persona key, '#', and its position.

turn.title: Turn
turn.description: A question and its answer share a turn.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: The key of the participant of the transcript who says the words.

message_kind.title: What it does
message_kind.description: What the message is: the question that opens the interview, a question that digs into what was just said, a question on a new topic, or an answer.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The plan topic the question targets.

follows_up_on.title: Digs into
follows_up_on.description: The earlier message that this question follows up on; empty when the question is not a follow-up.

covers.title: What it told us
covers.description: The data of the plan that this answer gave, as the interviewer judged it. The person who answers never sees it.

iteration.title: Iteration
iteration.description: 0 for the first interview, higher for rework rounds.
